mapper.select: select * from ai_prompt_template where category = #{category} and enabled = true order by usage_count desc, created_at desc
select * from ai_prompt_template where is_system = true and enabled = true order by created_at desc
select * from ai_prompt_template where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and enabled = true order by created_at desc
select * from ai_prompt_template where is_public = true and enabled = true order by usage_count desc, created_at desc
select * from ai_prompt_template where owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} and enabled = true order by created_at desc

update.foreach: update ai_prompt_template set usage_count = usage_count + #{item.usageIncrement}, updated_at = now() where id = #{item.id}

mapper.select: select category, is_system, count(*) as count from ai_prompt_template where enabled = true group by category, is_system
